title: Dynamically executing code is security sensitive
description: Avoid dynamically executing code as it can lead to security vulnerabilities.
why_is_this_an_issue: Dynamically executing code can lead to security vulnerabilities such as command injection, unauthorized access, and data corruption.
how_to_fix: Refactor code to avoid dynamic execution. Consider using safe libraries or functions for executing commands.
